stem: Which climbing practice best matches OSHA ladder requirements?
choices: Face the ladder while climbing and keep at least one hand available to grasp it
Climb sideways when carrying material to improve visibility
Carry any load that can be balanced against the chest
Use the stepladder top cap when the task lasts less than one minute
rationale: OSHA requires facing the ladder while climbing and using at least one hand to grasp it during ascent and descent.
